items.event: RB Leipzig vs Man City (UCL MD4)
items.line: City arrive on two straight Premier League defeats, with Leipzig's Maxime Estève saying the plan is to stop Haaland. City are favourites, having won four of six previous UCL meetings.

items.line: Arsenal are heavy favourites in Prague on the same Wednesday night as Leipzig-City. Other Wednesday ties include AEK Athens vs Real Madrid and Fenerbahce vs Liverpool.
